remarks: Enjoy resort like lifestyle at Rolling Ridge, one of the most desirable condo communities in Norwalk, nestled on park like grounds complete with pool, tranquil natural pond & paddle tennis. This top floor light, bright and airy condo is a quiet refuge filled with natural sun light throughout. Featuring open floor plan with spacious formal living room, updated kitchen with Corian countertops and all modern stainless-steel appliances. Adjacent dining room opens onto private deck with gorgeous views to both pool, pond and woodlands. Move-in ready, heat, hot and cold water and private (7 x 7 storage room) are all included in rent, washer and dryer in the unit. Reserved unassigned parking for 2 cars and plenty of visitor parking too. Conveniently located to 95, Merritt Parkway, new Merritt 7 Train station, Route 7, restaurants and shopping. Do not miss this tranquil Zen-like setting, among shady trees and water sounds. AGENTS PLEASE READ AGENT REMARKS REGARDING APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS!
